items.title: Ookwemin St 7 m Southeast of Villiers St to 93 m Southeast of Villiers St
items.description: Toronto-TMC: The proposed scope of work includes the advancement of 5 boreholes to a maximum depth of fifteen (15) metres below grade (mbg) within the roadway and public right-of-way along northwest portion of Ookwemin Street. All 5 boreholes will be completed as monitoring wells using 50 mm diameter Schedule 40 PVC pipe with 3-metre screens and flushto-grade casings. The work will be conducted using hydrovac to daylight locations first, followed by hollow-stem auguring, and each borehole/monitoring well will be sampled for soil and groundwater. Traffic control measures, including signage, barriers, and personnel, will be implemented where required, and the boreholes may require daylighting to safely expose underground utilities prior to drilling.

88B South Leaside will be adjusted to operate between St Clair Station and Wicksteed Avenue via Laird Station.

Buses will serve Warden Station on street at a new stop located on St Clair Avenue East near the Line 2 Bloor–Danforth overpass (Bay 1, Stop ID 16898). 
 
Service on 117 Birchmount South will no longer be interlined with service on 69 Warden South in all time periods on weekdays and weekends.

items.title: – Route change due to Easier Access construction
items.description: Service on 69 Warden South and 135 Gerrard will be adjusted in all time periods on weekdays and weekends to operate to Warden Station on-street via a new temporary turnback loop as Warden Station Easier Access construction progresses. Buses will serve Warden Station on street at Bay 5 (Stop ID 16641).

items.title: 353 Steeles – Route change due to Annual Network Plan
items.description:
Service on 353 Steeles will be extended from Pioneer Village Station to Martin Grove Loop via Steeles Avenue West in the overnight period on weekdays and weekends. With this change, service will be removed from Northwest Gate, Ian Macdonald Boulevard and The Pond Road. 
 
Customers can continue to use alternative service on 335 Jane or 341 Keele.

items.title: 100 Flemingdon Park – Route change due to Ontario Line construction
items.description: Service on 100 Flemingdon Park will be adjusted in all time periods on weekdays and weekends to operate to Pape Station via Pape Avenue as Ontario Line construction at Pape Station progresses. With this change, service will be removed from Broadview Avenue and O’Connor Drive.

items.title: – Route change due to operational considerations
items.description:
Service on the 300B Bloor-Danforth, 334 Eglinton and 386 Scarborough will be removed from Eglinton Avenue East at South Service Road East Side stop (Stop ID 16339) due to operational considerations. 
 
With this change, the outbound routing on the 300B Bloor-Danforth and 386 Scarborough will be adjusted to exit Kennedy Station via Transway Crescent and Kennedy Road. With this change, service will be added to Eglinton Avenue East at Kennedy Road stop (Stop ID 3539) to facilitate transfers with connecting trips. 
 
Service on the 334 Eglinton and 343 Kennedy will also be removed from South Service Road at Transway Crescent stop (Stop ID 12198) due to operational considerations.

items.title: 112 West Mall – REVISED - Temporary route change due to sewer repairs
items.description:
Revised routing - Extended to October 1, 2026, 7 a.m.


 
112 West Mall buses will divert both ways via Renforth and Eringate drives.
 
Stops not served: Gentian Drive between Renforth and Wellesworth drives, Wellesworth Drive between Gentian Drive and Rangoon Road, Eringate Drive between Rangoon Road and Wellesworth Drive.

items.title: 72 Pape – Route change due to Ontario Line construction
items.description:
Southbound service on 72 Pape will be adjusted in all time periods on weekdays and weekends as Ontario Line construction at Pape Station progresses. With this change, southbound service will resume servicing Pape Station via the partially reopened bus terminal. 
 
Further, service at the southern end of line will be adjusted to operate via Don Roadway, Lake Shore Boulevard East and Saulter Street South instead of Saulter Street South, Lake Shore Boulevard East and Bouchette Street to provide an accessible connection to 114 Queens Quay East at the final 72C Pape stop. The final southbound 72C stop will change from Commissioners Street at Saulter Street South (Stop ID 6319) to Commissioners Street at Don Roadway (Stop ID 16443).

items.title: – Route change due to operational considerations
items.description:
Service on the 12 Kingston Rd, 20 Cliffside, 21 Brimley and 57 Midland will be removed from stop Eglinton Avenue East at South Service Road East Side (Stop ID 16339) due to operational considerations. 
 
With this change, the outbound routing in the early morning period on weekdays and weekends will be adjusted to exit Kennedy Station via Transway Crescent and Kennedy Road. Service will be added to stop on Eglinton Avenue East at Kennedy Road (Stop ID 3539) to facilitate transfers with connecting trips.

items.title: To Carlingview Via Belfield – Route change due to Annual Service Plan
items.description:
Service on 45B Kipling (Kipling Station - Carlingview via Belfield) will be removed in all time periods on weekdays relating to the introduction of new service on 145 Belfield. 
 
With this change, service on 45A Kipling (Kipling Station - Steeles) will be increased to maintain 10 minute service along the Kipling corridor.

items.title: – Route change due to Easier Access construction
items.description: Southbound service on 16 McCowan and 17 Birchmount will be adjusted in all time periods on weekdays and weekends to operate to Warden Station via Birchmount Road, Danforth Road, Mack Avenue and Warden Avenue, as Warden Station Easier Access construction progresses. Buses will serve Warden Station on street at Bay 5 (Stop ID 16641).

items.title: – Route change due to Easier Access construction
items.description: Service on the 8 Broadview will be interlined with service on the 9 Bellamy in all time periods on weekdays and weekends as Warden Station Easier Access construction continues. With this change, service will be adjusted to serve Warden Station via stops on St Clair Avenue East. Southbound buses will pick up customers at the existing St Clair Avenue East at Warden Avenue West Side stop (Bay 2, Stop ID 14055), while northbound buses will pick up at a new stop located on St Clair Avenue East near the Line 2 Bloor–Danforth overpass (Bay 1, Stop ID 16898).

items.title: 16 Mccowan – Temporary route change due to storm drain repair
items.description:
16 McCowan buses will divert as follows:
 
Southbound: from south on Danforth Road, west on Mack Avenue and north on Warden Avenue, to Warden Station. 
Northbound: from east on St Clair Avenue East, south on Kennedy Road and north on Danforth Road, to regular route. 
 
Stops not served: westbound St Clair Avenue East, southbound Warden Avenue.

items.title: 102 Markham Rd – Temporary route change due to road work
items.description:
102C Markham Road buses will divert southbound via west on McNicoll Avenue and south on Dynamic Drive, to regular route. 
 
Stops not served: Dynamic Drive between McNicoll and Passmore avenues, Passmore Avenue between Dynamic Drive and Markham Road.

items.title: 68 Warden – REVISED - Temporary route change due to City of Markham work
items.description:
68B Warden buses will divert both ways via Glenbourne Park Drive.
 
Stops not served: Warden Avenue between Glenbourne Park Drive and Major Mackenzie Drive East, Major Mackenzie Drive East between Warden Avenue and Glenbourne Park Drive.

items.title: 43 Kennedy – Temporary route change due to road construction
items.description:
43 Kennedy buses will divert southbound via south on Silver Star Boulevard and west on Passmore Avenue, to regular route. 
 
Stops not served: Steeles Avenue East between Silver Star Boulevard and Midland Avenue, Midland Avenue between Steeles Avenue East and Passmore Avenue, and Passmore Avenue between Midland Avenue and Silver Star Boulevard.

items.title: – Long Branch Loop Streetcar Track Renewal Work
items.description:
With the start of the TTC construction at Long Branch Loop service will be adjusted on the following routes: 
 
501 Queen: 501A Queen streetcar will be extended to operate in the late evening period between Neville Park Loop and Humber Loop. Streetcars will continue to arrive every 10 minutes. 
 
Service on the 501C Queen will be suspended during this construction period. 
 
301 Queen: Overnight service on the 301 Queen streetcar will be shortened to operate between Neville Park Loop and Humber Loop. 
 
301L Queen bus replacement service will be introduced between Long Branch Loop and Dufferin Gate Loop via The Queensway, Park Lawn Road and Lake Shore Boulevard West. Buses will arrive every 30 minutes. 
 
507 Long Branch: Service on the 507 Long Branch streetcar will be suspended and replaced by 507 Long Branch bus replacement service. 
 
507 Long Branch bus replacement service will operate between Humber Loop and Long Branch Loop via Lake Shore Boulevard West, Park Lawn Road and The Queensway. 
 
Buses will arrive every 10 minutes and be extended into the late evening period to replace suspended 501C Queen streetcar service. 
 
507M Long Branch bus replacement shuttle service will begin operating between Humber Loop and Humber Bay Shores (Marine Parade Drive and Silver Moon Drive) via The Queensway, Park Lawn Road, Lake Shore Boulevard West and Marine Parade Drive.
 
Buses will arrive 15 minutes during the weekday peak periods and between 20 and 30 minutes in off peak periods. 
 
Service on the 508 Lake Shore streetcar will be suspended for the summer.

items.title: – Route change due to end of TTC track work
items.description:
Regular streetcar service will resume on the 501/301 Queen as TTC track work ends on Queen Street East between Broadview Avenue and Davies Avenue. 
 
The 301B Queen bus replacement service will be removed.

items.title: 503 Kingston Rd – Route change due to end of TTC track work
items.description:
The 503 Kingston Rd replacement bus will no longer divert as the TTC track work ends on Queen Street East between Broadview Avenue and Davies Avenue. 
 
With this change, regular service will resume on Queen Street East between Broadview Avenue and King Street East, and on King Street East between Queen Street East and Parliament Street.

items.title: – Route change due to rail bridge construction
items.description:
Streetcar service on 512 St Clair and 312 St Clair will be shortened to end at Lansdowne Avenue instead of Gunns Loop (Keele Street) to accommodate railway underpass construction in preparation for the new St Clair–Old Weston transit station. 
 
512B St Clair bus replacement service will be introduced between Gunns Loop and Lansdowne Station. 
 
Eastbound buses will operate via St Clair Avenue West, Lansdowne Avenue, Dupont Street, Symington Avenue, Bloor Street West and Lansdowne Avenue. 
 
Westbound buses will operate via Lansdowne Avenue and St Clair Avenue West. 
 
During the overnight period, bus service on 340 Junction will be extended to Oakwood Avenue via St Clair Avenue West.

items.title: – Route change due to City and TTC construction on College/Carlton streets between Bay Street and Church Street
items.description: Westbound 506B Carlton and 306B Carlton bus replacement service will be adjusted to divert via Yonge Street, Wellesley Street West and Bay Street as the construction progresses. Eastbound bus replacement service and streetcar service will remain unchanged.

items.title: – Route change due to City and TTC construction
items.description:
Westbound 506B/306B Carlton bus replacement service will be adjusted to divert via Parliament Street, Carlton Street, Yonge Street and Wellesley Street as the portion of Carlton Street construction ends. 
Eastbound 506B/306B Carlton replacement buses will continue to operate via Spadina Avenue, College Street, Carlton Street, Parliament Street, and Gerrard Street East. 
 
506/306 Carlton streetcars will continue to divert via Bay Street, Dundas Street, and Parliament Street while construction activities remain underway within the corridor. 
 
Please note: These route changes will not be reflected on the TTC’s Routes and Schedules pages or most trip‑planning apps.

items.title: – Temporary route change due to Toronto Hydro work
items.description:
501/301 Queen streetcars will divert both ways via King and Shaw streets. 
 
501/301 Queen replacement buses will operate between Bathurst Street and Sunnyside Loop via Queen Street West. 
 
Westbound: from Wolseley Loop, south on Bathurst Street and west on Queen Street West/The Queensway, to Sunnyside Loop. 
Eastbound: from Sunnyside Loop, east on The Queensway/Queen Street West, north on Bathurst Street and east on Wolseley Street, to Wolseley Loop. 
 
Transfer points: 
Eastbound buses: board on the south side of The Queensway, west of Roncesvalles Avenue. 
Westbound streetcars: board on the east side of King Street West, south of Queen Street West. 
Westbound buses: board on the north side of Queen Street West, east of Shaw Street.
Eastbound streetcars: board on the south side of Queen Street West, west of Strachan Avenue.
